summary: Canada Lookouts lists a British Columbia lookout named Four Mile in Bulkley-Nechako; a Four Mile Mountain sits close to the listed point. No history found.

evidence.supports: Four Mile is listed among British Columbia lookouts
Entry places Four Mile in Bulkley-Nechako
Entry gives coordinates 55.272 N, 127.550 W and elevation 686 (no unit printed)
Gazetteer records Four Mile Mountain as an official name
Gazetteer coordinates of Four Mile Mountain, latitude 55.275
Gazetteer coordinates of Four Mile Mountain, longitude -127.553889

sources.title: Four Mile Mountain

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the Canada Lookouts entry (region, coordinates, elevation) and the federal gazetteer entry for Four Mile Mountain (official name, 55.275, -127.553889, about 0.4 km from the listed point). No history, builder, status, agency or access found. The elevation (686) has no unit on the page; the record treats it as metres. Region check needed: the listed coordinates lie close to the village of New Hazelton, which I believe is in the Regional District of Kitimat-Stikine rather than Bulkley-Nechako. That is my recollection, not from a source read here, so check the regional-district boundary before publishing; the story attributes the Bulkley-Nechako label to the entry. The gazetteer files the peak under the old Cassiar Land District. The record has no local_unit or county. Searches: three web searches (one over the per-tower budget; one quoted query returned nothing). The story is about 80 words, below the 120-word target, because no further source was found. The fact-check reworded the lookout-to-peak link: no source says the lookout is on Four Mile Mountain, so the story says only that the names match and the points are close.
